select deadline1.* from(select rownumber() over() as num, deadline.* from( SELECT A.CDATE busiDate, A.CALENDAR_ID marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday, A.CREATE_DEPT deptCode FROM MST_HOLIDAY A
A.CDATE < to_date(#{holidayDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
A.CDATE > to_date(#{holidayDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.CALENDAR_ID = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.IS_HOLIDAY = '0'
order by A.CDATE desc
order by A.CDATE asc
)deadline )deadline1 where deadline1.num = #{days,jdbcType=INTEGER}

select deadline1.* from(select rownumber() over() as num,deadline.* from( SELECT A.CDATE busiDate, A.CALENDAR_ID marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday, A.CREATE_DEPT deptCode FROM MST_HOLIDAY A
A.CDATE <= to_date(#{holidayDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
A.CDATE >= to_date(#{holidayDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.CALENDAR_ID = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.IS_HOLIDAY = '0'
order by A.CDATE desc
order by A.CDATE asc
)deadline )deadline1 where deadline1.num = 1
